corridor.note: Cells are every 1x1 degree cell intersected by the closed corridor's chained geometry: the solved NHPN edge paths, the recomputed mixed-ancestry chains (proved equal to the locked chain connectivity), the locked NHS fill spans, and the authored overlay chords.

requires: westbound directed edge selection over the closed topology
corridor elevation acquisition against the locked product URLs

sample_verification.policy: deterministic sample: the first, middle, and last cell of the sorted corridor cell list, downloaded in full, checksummed, and raster-inspected

selection_policy: among discovered GeoTIFF products of the catalog dataset whose bounding box covers the cell and whose download URL is inside the catalog allowlist, select the latest publication date; ties resolve to the lexically first sourceId

source_policy.one_meter_upgrade: remains gated per ADR-0007 and is not locked here
